records.name: GLYPH Immersive
records.tagline: a free tool for modular grid lettering
records.description: Draw rounded-pixel letterforms and shapes on an adjustable grid. Controls for spacing, corners and edges, plus free export. No signup, runs in browser.

records.name: ChatHop
records.tagline: Take your conversation anywhere.
records.description: Move your AI conversation to another assistant mid-thought, context included. Copy the whole chat as plain text or Markdown. Start with 20 free uses every month.

records.name: easyspecs.ai
records.tagline: The spec review platform
records.description: The gap between 1.5x and 100x isn't speed, it's trust!! AI agents generate code 100x faster than humans write it. But your team can't review it all. EasySpecs documents undocumented codebases and turns them into trustworthy specifications, so spec review becomes your new merge request review. Ground your agents in reality. Scale agentic development without babysitting. Document the foundation once. Review specs including Oracles and Rubrics and Ship code you actually verified.

records.name: Cline Desktop App
records.tagline: An open-source app for open-weight models
records.description: Cline Desktop gives you an open-source workspace to put your favourite model to work - run multiple agent sessions, automate recurring tasks, extend their capabilities through Cline’s Marketplace, and continue work from agents like Claude Code and Codex. Choose the models and providers that work best for you, while Cline’s agent harness, optimized for open-weight models, powers the work behind them. All without being tied to a closed ecosystem.

records.name: Cadenya
records.tagline: A hosted agentic loop to bring agentic possibilities to life
records.description: Cadenya is not a framework you bolt into your application stack. It's a hosted agentic loop. You connect tools using specs you already know, like OpenAPI and MCP, and Cadenya runs the agent for you. Out of the box it handles: * Context compaction * Tool approvals * Webhooks and SSE streaming * Embeddable widgets * SDKs in four languages It's model-agnostic. Point it at OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and it uses that for inference. Email support@cadenya.com to get a free month.

records.name: chat-recall
records.tagline: Ctrl+F for every conversation you've had with an AI
records.description: Your team has done months of work with AI assistants. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode each keep a full record of it, in its own format, and none can read the others. One command reads what they wrote and turns it into one searchable history. Passwords come out before anything leaves your computer. Your assistant searches it itself, so it stops asking what you decided last month. It also finds keys that leaked into old chats, and checks which still work.

records.name: Devin Voice
records.tagline: You say it, Devin ships it
records.description: Devin Voice lets you talk to Devin, Cognition's AI software engineer, and have it ship the work. Speak a task out loud and Devin plans, codes, and delivers. Powered by GPT-Live for natural conversation, with Cognition's new SWE-2 coding model under the hood. Try Devin at https://devin.ai.

records.name: Design Studio by Monday Merch
records.tagline: A browser canvas to design merch with over 1.000+ products
records.description: Think Figma, but for creating real products. Design Studio lets you design straight on the product: 1,000+ items, every angle in 2D (and selected products in 3D). Add your brand hub with a click to create designs instantly. Printing rules and requirements are baked in, so every design is ready for production. And of course, easily share and collaborate.

records.name: Raycast 2.0
records.tagline: The next generation of Raycast is here
records.description: Raycast 2.0 is built on a new foundation, redesigned from the inside out. Your shortcut to everything now brings AI that can take action across your apps, Automations for recurring tasks, and Projects to keep ongoing work together. Connect your own ChatGPT or Claude account and put AI to work alongside the commands and extensions you use every day. The best Launcher got even better.

records.name: Spaces
records.tagline: One shared space where your team and AI agents work
records.description: Spaces is a desktop app where your team and their AI agents share one space per project — shared chats, files, and scheduled routines. Use any LLM provider — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — or run local models on your own machine. Free to start.

records.name: Formesign
records.tagline: Add legally binding signature to your Google Form
records.description: Google Forms is great at collecting data from your users, but doesn't have the option to collect signatures. Formesign adds eSignature to the form you already built. Users sign on any device, everyone gets the signed PDF by email, an audit-ready copy saves to Drive, and responses sync to Sheets.

records.name: TIM PG
records.tagline: Anonymize sensitive data before pasting into AI tools
records.description: TIM PG is a strictly offline, 100% AI-free Windows utility. It automatically masks personal data from your clipboard before you paste it into LLMs, and seamlessly restores the sensitive data back into the AI's response. Features document anonymization (PDF, Office) and Smart Bubble technology to protect text segments locally on your PC. No cloud, no leaked data—just secure local data privacy for your workflows.

records.name: Jackalope
records.tagline: Codex, Claude Code, Grok, + OpenCode in one shared workspace
records.description: Jackalope brings Codex, Claude Code, Grok, and OpenCode into one shared workspace. Run tasks in parallel Git worktrees, keep project context together, and review changes before applying them. Jackalope handles finding the best model, providing MCP tooling / shared context, tracking usage & quotas, managing any agent and multiple accounts (work / personal), recurring tasks, codebase visualization, computer use, browser use, and more. Cross-platform, open-source. Join the early-access list now,

records.name: Accordio
records.tagline: Give Claude the admin tools is missing
records.description: The tools Claude is missing: track time, sign contracts, send invoices, get paid. Free MCP connector for Claude, Claude Code, and any agent.

records.name: LiveGrid
records.tagline: Watch multiple live streams at once, never miss a thing
records.description: LiveGrid lets you watch multiple live streams in one grid - Twitch, YouTube and Kick side by side. Build your own multistream layout for esports, sports and the World Cup. Free in your browser.

records.name: Anysite.io
records.tagline: Build and enrich B2B lists by chatting to your agent
records.description: Anysite.io is a B2B data layer living in your favorite AI agent. Ask your agent for the list you need — companies by geo, industry, and size; the people inside them; their current job titles and emails — and Anysite.io returns it. No queries to write, no scrapers to maintain. Works over MCP or REST API inside Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other agents. Plug in and launch your outbound data collection the same day.

records.name: Wisry
records.tagline: Clone the ads already winning in your market, at scale
records.description: AI agents that run the whole play: scan the Meta and TikTok ad libraries for the ads already winning in your market, clone them into your brand as static and video ads, and launch to Meta and Google, optimized for ROAS. Winning ads, without the guesswork.

records.name: Sliick
records.tagline: Free 3D mockups for your screenshots and videos
records.description: Turn screenshots and videos into beautiful 3D device mockups, right in your browser. Choose a scene, customize shapes and colors, adjust the camera, and add motion. Export images or videos for free, with no account or watermark. Your media stays on your device. Made by Liinks.

records.name: Loqua
records.tagline: Speak naturally and move from thoughts to being done
records.description: Your thoughts shouldn’t have to slow down for a keyboard. With Loqua, you can speak naturally to turn rough ideas into ready-to-use writing, understand what’s on your screen, listen when you’d rather not read, and move work forward by voice - from rewriting and translation to scheduling and coding workflows. Less typing, less context switching, more time in flow.

records.name: sizeless
records.tagline: Spatial AI for underground infrastructure
records.description: sizeless turns a smartphone video of an open trench into the documentation utilities and contractors are legally required to produce: a 3D model, CAD/BIM plans, and the quantities they bill from. Today that takes months and a surveyor. We do it in hours, from a video the crew films themselves.

records.name: Moji
records.tagline: Open Markdown files like PDFs.
records.description: Open Markdown like a document: fast, clean, and distraction-free. Moji is a lightweight reader and editor for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with live preview, Mermaid diagrams, and PDF, HTML, and PNG export.

records.name: Jarvey — proactive AI Agent
records.tagline: Right in your Google Meet & Zoom calls
records.description: Meet Jarvey – finally a proactive AI agent in your Google Meet and Zoom calls, not just a silent notetaker An active meeting ai assistant who: – looks things up live – builds docs with you – set up tasks – catches what everyone else missed Powered by GPT-Live from @OpenAI

records.name: 2M Pixel World
records.tagline: A Digital World. Your Place in It.
records.description: 2M Pixel World - Buy pixels on the 2M Pixel Canvas, claim exclusive territory, grab member perks, and explore our ecosystem of autonomous B2B supply chain matching, precision manufacturing, and corporate ventures. Find more @https://www.2mpixel.world/perks

records.name: Lantern DSSE
records.tagline: Open-source network security, under your control
records.description: Lantern DSSE is a self-hosted Secure Service Edge combining ZTNA, TLS inspection, DLP, DNS control and SaaS tenant restrictions. Keep traffic inspection in your own infrastructure, with code you can inspect. Apache-2.0, with signed macOS and Windows packages. Experimental release for lab evaluation.

records.name: Unlisted Careers
records.tagline: Jobs from company career sites, hours before the boards.
records.description: Unlisted reads open jobs straight from the systems companies hire through and checks each one at the source every four hours. No ghost jobs, no reposts. Search 345,321 live openings, get a fit score from your resume, and alerts the hour a job appears.

records.name: Luen
records.tagline: Free GST & Multi-Currency Invoice Generator
records.description: Generate professional GST and multi-currency PDF invoices online for free. Instant vector PDF download with CGST/SGST/IGST and LUT export compliance.

records.name: Tilly
records.tagline: Your calendars, tasks, and morning brief in one place
records.description: I built Tilly because I kept checking my work calendar, personal calendar, and task list to figure out what to do next. Tilly puts Google, Outlook, iCloud, CalDAV, and ICS calendars in one view with your tasks and a morning brief. It can suggest a change, but it will not touch your calendar until you approve it. Available on iPhone, Mac, and the web.

records.name: Aluminum Door Smart Lock STAD-A1
records.tagline: Launching - Intelligent Aluminum Door Smart Lock STAD-A1
records.description: STAD-A1 smart door lock with fingerprint, PIN, RFID card, and TTLock app control. IP65 waterproof stainless-steel smart lock for aluminum doors.

records.name: Motor Insurance Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate motor insurance premiums & check IDV
records.description: Motor Insurance Calculator launches as an offline-first tool for insurance agents, POS executives, vehicle dealers, and vehicle owners. It combines premium estimation for cars, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles and taxis with branded PDF quotations, IDV/OD/TP/NCB calculations, add-ons, RTO utilities, EMI, cash counter, renewal tracking and QR tools. Its key advantage is fast offline access to essential insurance and field-work utilities in one app.

records.name: Branding Budget Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate your branding budget in India in under 2 minutes
records.description: A free calculator that helps startups and businesses in India estimate an indicative budget for branding, packaging design, visual identity and complete brand-launch projects. Adjust the scope, business stage, SKU complexity, timeline and optional services to create a practical planning range.

records.name: CookieClean Pro
records.tagline: Clean cookies without getting logged out — ever
records.description: Most cookie cleaners log you out of Gmail, Facebook, and every other site. CookieClean Pro is smarter. It removes tracking cookies and junk data while keeping all your sessions active — no re-login, ever. ✅ One-click cookie cleaning ✅ Stay logged into all accounts ✅ Removes only junk & tracking cookies ✅ Lightweight Chrome extension ✅ Free tier + Pro plan available

records.name: BlazeBot
records.tagline: Habit Tracker via Discord
records.description: BlazeBot turns Discord into a simple habit tracker. Create daily, weekly or monthly habits, get scheduled check-ins, build streaks, join challenges with friends, track progress, and earn achievements and profile cosmetics.

records.name: Lunbi
records.tagline: Track weekly habits and watch your world grow
records.description: Lunbi is a weekly habit tracker for iPhone and iPad. Set a goal like reading three times a week, then tap to record each day you read. As you keep going, your little world grows with new islands, stars, and other details. Miss a day? You can still reach your weekly goal. No sign-up required. Choose an annual subscription or pay once for lifetime access. Eligible new subscribers get a 14-day free trial on the annual plan, which renews automatically unless canceled.

records.name: PDF Toolkit
records.tagline: Edit, Convert, Merge & Manage PDFs Offline
records.description: PDF Toolkit is an all-in-one PDF app for Android that helps you edit, merge, split, compress, convert, scan, sign, and secure PDF documents from one place. Built for students, professionals, and everyday users, it combines powerful document tools with a privacy-focused approach, allowing many operations to run directly on your device. Manage PDFs faster without juggling multiple apps.

records.name: Piggy Points
records.tagline: A reward chart your kid actually checks
records.description: Piggy Points is a chore & reward chart for kids 5–12. Parents add tasks with point values, kids check them off, points fill the piggy and buy the reward they chose — screen time, a movie pick, the Lego set. Less nagging, visible progress. Free to start.

records.name: Well Plate Designer
records.tagline: Design well plates fast and visually, stop using Excel
records.description: If you've ever mapped samples, controls, and standards into a 96 or 384-well plate using a spreadsheet, you know how error-prone and tedious it gets: one misplaced cell can ruin an entire ELISA or PCR run. Well Plate Designer replaces that spreadsheet with a fast, visual interface built specifically for lab workflows. Built to make plate planning faster, clearer, and less error-prone. Would love your feedback!

records.name: CAT-Chemicals
records.tagline: Professional Waterproofing & Protection Solutions
records.description: Cat Chemicals provide premium waterproofing products in Pakistan. We offer roof, wall, basement, and concrete waterproofing solutions for lasting protection.

records.name: Maître Luc Wêtê Agbonon
records.tagline: Marabout Sérieux
records.description: Marabout africain sérieux né à Sakété (Bénin), trente ans de pratique, rituels filmés au temple. Premier échange gratuit, réponse 24h/24.

records.name: YBS
records.tagline: Fast browser tools for developers, with no sign-up
records.description: YBS is a lightweight suite of browser-based tools for developers and everyday technical tasks. Format JSON, test cron expressions, decode JWTs, convert Unix timestamps, work with Base64, regex, text, and more — all without sign-up. Many tools process data locally in your browser, keeping workflows fast and private.

records.name: Coquiet.app
records.tagline: Continuous focus music, a focus timer, and quiet company.
records.description: Coquiet brings the quiet company of a café or library to your focus sessions. Enter a shared online room, choose some music, and settle into work, study, or reading. A live presence indicator lets you know others are there too, while an optional focus timer helps structure your session. No accounts, cameras, or chat—just a little company while everyone does their own thing. Free to use, with optional support. Designed for desktop; it works on mobile too, though the experience is different.

records.name: SeamUI
records.tagline: We kept the models and deleted the chat.
records.description: Generate, organize and scale AI images and videos across leading models with your own API keys. OpenAI, Gemini, Black Forest Labs (Flux), Grok AI and aggregators such as Kie.ai and Replicate are available through our interface. Find inspiration in our prompt library, save yours, and use them in any project, alone or with your team.

records.name: ThinkPad
records.tagline: Thinking process in a canvas
records.description: ThinkPad is a mind-mapping canvas for breaking a complicated question down into a tree of smaller ones. Start with one question at the centre, and branch out as you go to discover. No login is required, and all the information stays in your browser

records.name: TetherCam
records.tagline: Your iPhone as a USB webcam for Mac and OBS
records.description: Two free apps turn your iPhone into a USB webcam for your Mac. Select TetherCam in Zoom, Teams, Meet or another app that lists system cameras. The Mac app outputs 1080p30 video; choose a separate microphone for calls. The optional OBS plugin receives video and iPhone microphone audio. Requires iOS 17+ and macOS 14+ for the Mac app. Free and open source.

records.name: Textlift
records.tagline: Offline OCR that keeps your columns and tables intact
records.description: Textlift pulls the text out of screenshots, photos, scans and PDFs and keeps the layout — columns stay columns, tables stay tables. It works fully offline: the recognition data ships inside the app, so nothing you scan ever leaves your computer and there are no network requests at all. A one-time purchase on the Microsoft Store, not a subscription.

records.name: WalkAITalkie
records.tagline: Local dictation and text cleanup for your Mac
records.description: Dictate messages, notes and prompts on an Apple-silicon Mac with macOS 26+. The direct download includes local dictation, Raw and Clean, and 10 history entries for free. Pro adds formats, translation and microphone-session summaries through a one-time purchase. Review the generated text before using it. The Mac App Store app uses the clipboard; its version, features and purchases may differ.

records.name: Zorow — CRM, Invoicing & WhatsApp
records.tagline: CRM, invoicing & WhatsApp marketing for growing businesses
records.description: Zorow is an all-in-one business platform combining CRM, invoicing, WhatsApp marketing, sales management, and automation in one simple workspace. Manage leads, customers, deals, invoices, campaigns, follow-ups, and business performance without switching between multiple tools. Built for small and growing businesses, Zorow helps you save time, stay organized, automate repetitive tasks, and grow faster.

records.name: ChatClash
records.tagline: Turn your WhatsApp group chat into stats, awards & games
records.description: ChatClash turns your WhatsApp group chat into a Wrapped-style experience with message stats, rankings, awards, party games, roasts and shareable cards. Your export is analyzed locally in the browser, so the original chat file stays on your device. Try the free preview and expose your group.

records.name: League Winner Sports
records.tagline: A 10x solution to managing your fantasy basketball team.
records.description: A powerful, simple and intuitive way to manage your fantasy basketball team against those who spend hours researching. Our site works with ESPN, Yahoo, Fantrax, and Sleeper, and differs from existing solutions that just show stats in a static table and leave the decision to you.

records.name: Kickx
records.tagline: The live transfer market for brands.
records.description: Kickx turns football line-ups into a live marketplace. Choose a position, enter your brand or X handle, and make your move. Brands compete for places in the Starting XI, with higher bid offers taking the shirt. Each team sheet has its own matchday story, claim an open position, challenge the current starter, get featured on the team sheet, watch the market change live, see your brand badge on the pitch, and share your player profile.

records.name: minitok
records.tagline: AI coding with a verification loop, not just code generation
records.description: minitok is a repository-aware coding workflow CLI that adds research, planning, implementation, deterministic verification, review, repair, and evidence recording to AI-assisted development. Unlike unstructured code-generation tools, it gives every repository change a repeatable control loop. It supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and OpenAI-compatible providers, with local-first execution and opt-in telemetry disabled by default. This launch focuses on traceability,

records.name: Otiya
records.tagline: AI-powered live quizzes, kids’ trivia & prize draws
records.description: Otiya turns knowledge into play, learning and participation. Create quizzes from a prompt or document with AI, use templates, host live or play solo, run prize draws, and explore Otiya Kids, where children 6–12 learn together by taking turns on one device. Nonprofits can turn campaigns into interactive experiences that help people learn, engage and take action. Players join by QR or game code, with no app or account.

records.name: 13lend
records.tagline: Connect with people through mutual interests
records.description: 13lend is a social app that connects people through shared interests. It functions similarly to popular dating apps that some may be familiar with, but instead of focusing on romance, its main goal is to help people find friends and communities built around the things they enjoy. What sets 13lend apart is that anyone can create a community, and every member has a voice in shaping it. Members can propose and vote on changes in the community that help improve it's quality.

records.name: Scheduler for WhatsApp
records.tagline: High-precision WhatsApp scheduling and auto-wake for macOS
records.description: Sub-millisecond automated WhatsApp booking and messaging scheduler for macOS. Native launchd background service and instant unlock dispatch.

records.name: Cursos en Video
records.tagline: Turn any topic into an AI-curated YouTube course
records.description: "Convierte cualquier tema en una ruta de aprendizaje estructurada a partir de vídeos de YouTube, curada por IA: sin contenido repetido, ordenada por prerrequisitos, con tiempo estimado."— está bien, es tu descripción oficial de la web. Solo un detalle: el resto del listado (eslogan, comentario) lo estamos poniendo en inglés porque PH es internacional — si quieres coherencia total, dime y te la traduzco; si no, dejarla en español tampoco es un problema.

records.name: AppSign
records.tagline: L’émargement Qualiopi, sans prise de tête.
records.description: L’émargement numérique simple pour les organismes de formation français. AppSign permet de faire signer vos apprenants en quelques secondes sur tablette ou via QR code, puis génère automatiquement les preuves d’émargement, PDF scellés et exports Excel. Pensé pour les exigences de la formation professionnelle et les audits Qualiopi. Sans installation, sans abonnement et sans limite de signatures.

records.name: SignPricer
records.tagline: Free sign pricing calculators for small sign shops
records.description: SignPricer gives small sign shops free, browser-based pricing calculators and quote tools for banners, vinyl lettering, vehicle graphics, yard signs, channel letters, decals, and installation. It also includes a quote builder, transparent pricing methodology, a vinyl decal pricing chart, and a downloadable quote template. No account or subscription is required.

records.name: Position Intelligence
records.tagline: Position-aware market intelligence for crypto traders
records.description: Enter your crypto spot, long, or short positions and see only the developments that bear on them. Position Intelligence filters noise, scores materiality, shows exposure-aware arithmetic, monitors thesis assumptions, and cites every source. No exchange keys.

records.name: Eggy - The Great Hatch
records.tagline: Run. Slide. Survive.
records.description: Meet Eggy 🥚 — an egg that hatches too early. Hatchery Seven. Eggs wait to become chickens. One cracks too soon: just a shell and two tiny feet. Through the cages he sees the truth. The line does not raise chickens. It cooks them. Last stop: a box stamped NUGGETS. If he hatches here, that box is his future. So he runs. Still an egg. Hold to slide under blades. Release to run over crates. Escape before you hatch.

records.name: Bayan Flow (0.5.0)
records.tagline: Learn algorithms through step-by-step visualizations
records.description: Bayan Flow is a free, open-source algorithm visualizer with a live in-browser Python editor, video export, and full Arabic RTL support. Version 0.5.0 adds two new categories: tree traversals and graph algorithms, plus a pseudocode tab for every algorithm. You can also sign in with Google to save favorite algorithms and write per-algorithm study notes that follow you across sessions. Still 100% free and open-source for all students and teachers.

records.name: Postille
records.tagline: Video reviews into native markers. No cloud, no account.
records.description: Postille is a native macOS app for video review. Write comments on a frame, or import from Frame.io, Vimeo, CSV, or a Resolve EDL. Generate a Web Review: one HTML file clients open in a browser to leave timecoded comments, no account, no server. Export markers to Final Cut, Premiere, Resolve, Avid, SRT, or PDF. You handle video transport yourself (Vimeo, WeTransfer, etc); Postille only owns the review layer, and that stays on your Mac. Free during the beta, paid on the Mac App Store at release.

records.name: NoxLumin Solar Motion Sensor Wall Light
records.tagline: Solar security light with aluminum housing and PIR sensing
records.description: An outdoor solar wall light for garages, side doors, patios, sheds and barns where wiring is inconvenient. Choose 450, 900 or 1,100 lumens, with 1,500–6,000mAh batteries, PIR motion detection, four lighting modes, and IP65 protection. The main housing uses sandblasted, anodized aluminum instead of plastic for better long-term outdoor durability.

records.name: Mochi Table
records.tagline: One place for all your work. No servers, no monthly bill.
records.description: Build a customer list, a hiring tracker, or anything else your team needs. It all lives on your own computer, there is nothing to run and no monthly bill, and Claude, Codex and OpenCode can work in it with you.

records.name: ClipScrub
records.tagline: Redact sensitive information entirely on your Mac
records.description: Redact sensitive details in screenshots, PDFs and documents locally on your Mac. Review detections before exporting a copy. Includes an open-source engine and CLI. Free 14-day trial, no account required. $29 once.

records.name: xMailman
records.tagline: A one-binary, self-hosted mailing list manager.
records.description: A one-binary, self-hosted mailing list manager. Manage mailing lists, subscriptions, archives, and moderation from a single static binary. A modern, self-contained alternative to GNU Mailman.

records.name: My Pedalboard
records.tagline: Build and share pedalboards with FX loops and sound demos
records.description: My Pedalboard lets guitarists and bassists document and share their real signal chains — pedal order, amps, FX loops, gear notes, and images. You can also attach a YouTube demo so people can hear the setup, not just see it. Each board gets a shareable page, making it easy to show how a complete rig is connected and what it sounds like.

records.name: Fontsum
records.tagline: Free font discovery, font pairings, and typography tools
records.description: Fontsum is a simple, easy-to-use font discovery and directory website for designers and creatives. Browse and discover free fonts through categories, tags, and designer collections, with useful font previews and licensing information. Fontsum also has a growing collection of hand-curated font pairings and a Fancy Text generator for creating styled text. No signup or paywall — just a simple, minimal place to discover fonts and typography resources.

records.name: MusixBlvd • Home
records.tagline: Mikey: The AI Decision Engine for Digital Growth
records.description: Mikey isn’t another analytics dashboard or AI chatbot. Mikey is an AI decision engine that analyzes authorized platform data to identify what’s driving growth, uncover opportunities, and recommend the next best move. Instead of just showing what happened, Mikey helps creators and entertainment professionals understand what’s working and what actions to take next. Currently integrated with SoundCloud and YouTube, with more platforms coming soon.

records.name: Metis
records.tagline: Build AI environments, not setup scripts
records.description: Metis is an open-source CLI that scaffolds and evolves local development environments for RAG, Agents, and MCP. It handles Docker, dependencies, environment configuration, vector databases, Redis, project metadata, health checks, and safe capability addition so developers can spend less time wiring setup and more time building AI functionality.

records.name: SOLE'D - Your Collection, Valued
records.tagline: Know What Your Sneaker Collection Is Actually Worth.
records.description: SOLE’D is a sneaker valuation and collection app built to answer one simple question: What is your sneaker collection actually worth? Scan a physical sneaker with your phone, get an estimated value based on the specific pair and its condition, and track the value of your entire collection in one place. I built SOLE’D because I wanted an easier way to understand the value sitting in my own closet without manually looking up every pair. We are live on the App Store!

records.name: Carpets Online
records.tagline: Hibex Gold Yellow Carpet | Stain-Resistant Flooring
records.description: Add warmth and colour to your home with the Hibex Gold Carpet. This 9mm twist pile carpet is made from 100% polyester and designed for heavy domestic use, making it a practical choice for busy areas such as hallways, stairs and living rooms. With a durable action backing, 1.08 TOG rating and underfloor heating compatibility, it offers a comfortable and practical flooring option for everyday homes. It is also mild bleach cleanable and backed by a 10-year warranty.

records.name: ClickCutout
records.tagline: 1-click copy images from the web without their backgrounds
records.description: Grab a photo from the web and try it in your design. Right-click in Chrome, copy it without the background, and paste it into Figma, Canva or anywhere. ClickCutout skips the download-upload-download routine when you’re building moodboards, testing a mockup or making a social post. You can also download PNG or WebP with transparency, or JPEG with a background color you choose, at the original image dimensions. 10 free removals each month, with paid plans and one-time credit packs for more.

records.name: AttendKit
records.tagline: Know who attended your Google Meet, and for how long
records.description: AttendKit turns every Google Meet into an attendance report, automatically. Install it once and it tracks in the background. For every participant you get their join time, how long they stayed, and the percentage of the meeting they were actually present for — not just whether they showed up. Export to CSV or PDF, send a read-only report link to anyone, and share meetings with your team. Only names and timestamps are stored. Nothing is recorded. Free for your first 30 meetings.

records.name: Nuwelo
records.tagline: Smart Wellness for Modern Lifestyles.
records.description: Java Jolt is a chewable energy tablet with 50mg caffeine, CoQ10 & B vitamins - no water needed. FSSAI-licensed, chocolate-flavoured. 30 tablets/pack.

records.name: Elevate Boardroom
records.tagline: Talk through business decisions with your AI board
records.description: Think through business decisions with a board of AI advisors. Your CFO, CMO, COO and other advisors discuss the options with you, respond when you push back, and bring different perspectives. A chairman keeps the meeting moving, and you leave with a written summary and next steps. Built for solo founders and small teams. Try one free 30-minute meeting, no card required. Paid plans start at $49/month.

records.name: SourceNote: AI Meeting Notes
records.tagline: Turn conversations into notes you can verify and act on
records.description: SourceNote turns important conversations into meeting notes you can check and use. Record safely, review an editable transcript, then verify decisions and actions against the source. Ask questions scoped to one meeting, translate without replacing the original transcript, and keep processing choices explicit. It is built for work where a polished summary is not enough—you need clear, traceable next steps.

records.name: OPINIX
records.tagline: Your Voice.Real Reward
records.description: Connect with businesses, complete surveys, and earn rewards worldwide.

records.name: The Founders Network
records.tagline: A network for people who build, straight from the terminal.
records.description: Social media became a machine for wasting your time. So we built one for making things. The Founders Network is projects, ideas, code, and builders. No ads. No algorithm. No engagement bait. Web or terminal. And the terminal actually does something. Meet AHT: an LLM reliability layer that hit 0% measured hallucinations in our controlled tests. Don't believe us. Bring your API key. Feed it bad data. Contradict it. Push it until it breaks. Find the hallucination. Prove us wrong.

records.name: Mejl
records.tagline: Focused Gmail views. See less, read more.
records.description: Most Gmail clients dump you into one mixed inbox. Mejl turns labels into focused views with their own unread counts. Open work, receipts, or newsletters. Leave the rest alone. Gmail already has the tools. Mejl makes setup easy: a simple filter builder on Free, or describe a view and let Plus sort new mail. Your messages stay in Gmail. Web and iOS.

records.name: Locker Lounge — Pickup Soccer, Sorted
records.tagline: Replace your soccer group chat with a proper clubhouse
records.description: Every pickup soccer group runs on WhatsApp. RSVPs buried in noise, stats forgotten by next week, organizers stress-counting heads before kickoff. Locker Lounge fixes that. Create an invite-only club, schedule matches, get one-tap RSVPs, track goals/assists/clean sheets on seasonal leaderboards, balance teams with AI, and vote for Man of the Match after every game. Free on iOS and Android. Solo dev, built it for my own groups. Would love your feedback.

records.name: Anime Chibi Art Generator
records.tagline: Sprite generate consistent characters
records.description: Create your own anime chibi characters, personalize their look, and build reusable mascot kits, sprite animations, and reaction packs with Anime Chibi Art.

records.name: Photizy
records.tagline: Photo galleries for photographers who want to sell more.
records.description: One branded link where your clients pick their favourites, pay and download, with no account to create. Sell downloads and prints, watermark previews until payment, and keep 100% of every sale. Flat subscription, 0% commission. 15-day free trial, no card.

records.name: Kaamly
records.tagline: Designed to be deleted
records.description: Kaamly turns the roles, skills, locations, and ways of working you choose into a focused daily shortlist. An optional resume can suggest preferences, but you review and confirm them. Save, pass, restore, and evaluate roles with uncertainty made visible—not guessed away. Applications stay human-controlled and open on the employer’s site, while raw resumes and personal details remain inside Kaamly.

records.name: Bear
records.tagline: AI-driven package manager for Skills, Rules & Memory
records.description: CTXPM (Context Package Manager) is an open-source, AI-first protocol that organizes Skills, Rules, Prompts, Memory, and MCP into two clear ownership types - dependency and package - so your AI coding agent can check, update, and validate them on its own. * dependency: external AI resources (Git, OCI, file path) you don't own. Tracked by source/version, not committed to your repo. * package: resources your project owns. Reviewed and versioned right alongside your source code.

records.name: Moku Flashcards
records.tagline: Study less. Remember more.
records.description: Moku is a focused flashcard app for iOS. It adapts to every review, bringing difficult cards back sooner and giving familiar ones more time. Start with a deck from Discover, import Ankiapkg files, or make your own. No account, no ads, and your library stays on your device.

records.name: ChatGPT to Word & PDF
records.tagline: Export ChatGPT to Word & PDF — equations stay intact
records.description: Export ChatGPT to Word (.docx) and PDF in one click. Preserve math equations, tables, numbered lists, and formatting.

records.name: FRAME 37 — film camera for your phone.
records.tagline: Two films in one camera — Frame 37’s biggest update yet
records.description: Frame 37 brings the feeling of shooting real film to your phone. Load a roll, shoot without previews, rewind, and wait for development. This update introduces a redesigned camera and film library, a new film stock, and the ability for PRO users to keep two different rolls loaded and switch between them while shooting.

records.name: Website Audit Pro
records.tagline: Free website audits, now available on iOS
records.description: Audit any website directly from your iPhone or iPad. Check SEO, performance, technical issues and get clear recommendations in seconds. Website Audit Pro is now available for free on iOS.

records.name: EasyExtract
records.tagline: free extraction tools that run 100% in your browser.
records.description: EasyExtract is an independent website that publishes free online data extraction tools. The site exists for one everyday problem: useful data trapped in inconvenient formats — email addresses buried in messy text, tables locked inside PDFs, words stuck in screenshots and scans. Every tool here turns that problem into a solved one, in seconds, without any sign-up.

records.name: Stock Monitor Pro
records.tagline: Market Free AI-powered stock analysis & portfolio tracker
records.description: A free stock analysis platform for investors who want technical indicators, portfolio tracking and AI-powered market analysis in one place. EZ Market includes: • Technical analysis • RSI, MACD & EMA • Support & resistance • Stock scanner • Portfolio tracking • AI Trade Coach • Daily market briefing • US market monitoring • English & Spanish No subscription required. Try it here: https://ez-market.azurewebsites.net/

records.name: Nuwelo
records.tagline: Smart Wellness for Modern Lifestyles.
records.description: Nuwelo Brain Sense+ is a plant-based nootropic with Lipogen PSPA to support memory, focus & mental clarity. FSSAI-approved. Shop now with COD.

records.name: Quick Image Tools
records.tagline: Compress, resize & convert images directly in your browser.
records.description: Compress, resize, crop and convert JPG, PNG and WebP images for free, right in your browser. No signup, no uploads to a server — fast, private image tools.

records.name: TabMint
records.tagline: A privacy-first way to organize and clean your tabs
records.description: TabMint is a privacy-first Chrome extension for people who have too many tabs open. It helps you search, organize, group, detect duplicate and stale tabs, save sessions, and clean up clutter through a guided Review → Confirm → Clean → Undo workflow. Everything runs locally with no account, backend, analytics, or telemetry. TabMint uses minimal permissions and never needs access to page content.

records.name: Fastest Lap
records.tagline: Race your own ghost. Pay once, own every circuit
records.description: Top-down time-attack racer for iOS. 23 real-geometry circuits, a 20-round career, and a ghost of your best lap waiting on every track. No ads. No subscriptions. Pay once, own everything. Built solo — the whole game is smaller than the payment SDK inside it.

records.name: ChamsPilot
records.tagline: Your AI team for outreach, inbox, and deals
records.description: ChamsPilot is your AI team for finding opportunities, managing email, and moving deals forward. Discover brands, creators, companies, and decision-makers. Let EldinAct reach out and follow up for you. Inbox AI uses your tone, rates, and boundaries to reply and negotiate, automatically or with one click. Manage confirmed deals in shared workspaces for contracts, deliverables, and payments. Partners join with a secure PIN, no account needed.

records.name: Forkwind
records.tagline: Your AI growth agent for open-source repositories
records.description: You build the code. Forkwind grows the audience. Your AI growth agent studies your open-source repo, works on its visibility every day and helps real developers discover it. Build traction in stars, forks and followers, with the chance to attract contributors too. Follow real GitHub numbers and get a written report every week. Human-supervised. Free preview, no card. From $249/month. Cancel anytime.

records.name: Hutif - MCP server generator
records.tagline: Turn files, databases, and APIs into hosted MCP servers
records.description: Connect a table, database, API, or set of documents and get a live MCP server back in minutes - schema detected automatically, no code required.

records.name: Tearsheet
records.tagline: Extract design palettes that actually match what you see
records.description: A local design reference gallery for images and video. Claude Code catalogs each one, extracts its color palette, and can scaffold the mood, typography, and UI patterns straight into a new Figma file or Claude Design project. - jeanpaulbondy-la/tearsheet

records.name: Thenvue
records.tagline: Your life, remembered.
records.description: What if you could search your life like you search the internet? Thenvue is a private digital memory journal that helps you capture moments and find them again later. Write a memory, add a photo or voice note, and let AI understand what happened, when, and who was there. Later, ask Thenvue about your life instead of scrolling through endless photos and notes. Built around remembering, not just storing.

records.name: SiteClash
records.tagline: Get your website seen in free weekend battles
records.description: SiteClash brings eight live websites into one free weekend competition. Builders share their vote links, bringing visitors into a shared arena where they can discover the whole roster. Seven scheduled eliminations crown one winner, who earns a showcase until the next champion takes over. Every participant gets an official result and a lasting place in the Fight Archive. New and established projects are welcome. Reach depends on participants sharing; sponsorship never buys votes or rank.

records.name: Tabosmart
records.tagline: Less tab clutter. More headspace.
records.description: Bring related tabs together, review repeated pages, and save links for later. Tabosmart explains each suggestion and lets you choose what happens. Core suggestions work without AI. Optional local AI adds help on supported devices, with model inputs staying on your device. Free, with no account required. Built with your feedback.

records.name: DemoShots
records.tagline: Turn screen recordings into product stories
records.description: Create product demos with a beginning, a walkthrough, and a clear next step. Record your product in Chrome, add slides to set the scene, and use text overlays, zooms, and click highlights to explain what matters. Trim pauses, adjust the framing, and export an MP4 or WebM—all on your device, with no account required.

records.name: Pet Memorial Portrait
records.tagline: See your pet again — a memorial portrait from one photo
records.description: Pet Memorial Portrait turns one photo of the pet you miss into a custom, hand-finished-style portrait — with their name and dates written gently beneath.

records.name: MunchReach
records.tagline: The only cold outreach tool that helps you get quality leads
records.description: MunchReach is an all-in-one cold outreach platform that helps businesses automate their sales process, automate campaigns and follow-ups, personalize emails with AI, manage conversations, CRM, and track campaign performance, all from one platform.

records.name: Pixeldeed
records.tagline: Buy the Pixel. Own the Deed.
records.description: Buy the pixel. Own the deed.

records.name: ByToday
records.tagline: Assign, track, and crush today’s family to-dos effortlessly.
records.description: ByToday is a daily to-do app focused on finishing today's tasks today. Beyond personal lists, its superpower is family collaboration. Effortlessly assign chores to your partner or kids, send nudges, and track progress (accepted, active, done) in real-time.🚀 Features:• Delegate & Track: Send tasks to loved ones and monitor status at a glance.• Location Alerts: Get notified when arriving/leaving specific places.• Smart Add-ons: Apple Calendar sync, live weather, and privacy-first local storage.

records.name: MillionDollar
records.tagline: Grab your rank
records.description: Get on the board for $6 and climb by clicks — or pay $1 over the current #1 to seize the crown instantly.

records.name: LeadClue
records.tagline: Local businesses that stopped posting, ranked by silence
records.description: Local business leads ranked by how long they have gone quiet, with the phone, email and social profiles attached. Three free, then per lead, no subscription.

records.name: ADRIAN'S Metal Recyclers
records.tagline: Quality Parts, Smarter Recycling, Less Waste
records.description: We handle unwanted vehicles, scrap metal, and used automotive parts, helping customers make practical use of materials that might otherwise go to waste. Our services cover a range of vehicle and metal recycling needs, with a focus on responsible recycling and useful parts recovery across the Gold Coast.

records.name: One Line
records.tagline: Write a line anywhere on iPhone — it sorts itself
records.description: Type "dentist tomorrow 3pm" and it becomes an event. "call mom" becomes a to-do. Everything else stays a note. Three screens — Today, Notes, Calendar — and one box to write in. Built for capture on iOS: home and lock screen widgets, share sheet from any app, reminders, dictation, and text lifted out of screenshots. The sorting is a dictionary and a date parser, not an AI. It runs on device, and nothing leaves your phone until you switch sync on.

records.name: SpoolLedger: Filament Log
records.tagline: Private offline filament inventory and usage ledger
records.description: Track filament spools, remaining weight, print-job usage, original-currency material cost, storage location, and corrections. SpoolLedger works fully offline with no account, subscription, ads, analytics, or tracking.

records.name: TaxCredit4U
records.tagline: Your Business Earned an R&D Credit. Claim It!
records.description: Find out in three minutes whether your business qualifies for the federal R&D tax credit under IRC Section 41 - and get the documentation to claim it.

records.name: SpielCade
records.tagline: Play Free Browser Games Online & Publish To Earn
records.description: Tired of sketchy downloads and pop-up ads ruining your break? Meet Spielcade—a 100% free, instant-play browser gaming hub. We host 17,125+ HTML5 games across 25+ genres, built for zero friction on any device. No installs, no lag. Features fast search, unblocked tags, and a "Surprise Me" button. Join 500K+ active players enjoying a clean UI and a 4.9/5 rating. Just click and play!

records.name: Blessed
records.tagline: Social pay it forward random blessings app iso feedback
records.description: Random acts of kindness. Pay it forward. Whether you like to give or love when a stranger blesses you. This app allows a randomly selected user to be sent blessings using cash app or venmo.

records.name: VidSmaller
records.tagline: Compress video to an exact file size — no watermark
records.description: Type the size you need — 18 MB for email, 19 MB for Discord — and VidSmaller two-pass encodes your video to land just under it. Or pick constant quality (CRF), a bitrate ceiling, or just scale 4K down to 1080p. 33 input formats in; H.264/H.265 in MP4, MKV, WebM or MOV out. Encoding runs on our servers, so a Chromebook handles a 4K file as fast as a workstation. Never a watermark, on any plan. Files auto-delete after the job. No install, no account to try.

records.name: Hangly Hearts
records.tagline: Desktop charms that keep loved ones close
records.description: Hangly Hearts is a desktop photo frame for Mac that hangs your favourite photos from the top of your screen. Partners, family, pets, or memories you want nearby while you work. Unlike static widgets or social feeds, each keepsake swings on a real rope physics simulation. Grab it, flick it, let it settle. Clicks pass through everywhere else, so your desktop stays fully usable.

records.name: Mirasonic
records.tagline: YouTube Music in the Subsonic client you already use
records.description: Mirasonic is a free, self-hosted Subsonic server that makes YouTube Music searchable and playable in the client you already use. Your playlists, stars and listening history stay on your machine—no Google account or cookies.

records.name: Desi Bilona Cow Ghee
records.tagline: Best Desi Ghee In India
records.description: Shop for premium desi ghee made from fresh cow’s milk. Full of natural goodness, this desi ghee is perfect for cooking, fitness, and supporting a healthy lifestyle.

records.name: Page & Ribbon
records.tagline: Personal gift websites, without starting from scratch
records.description: Turn photos, memories and a letter into a personal gift website without coding. Choose a template, edit each page and preview the surprise. Building is free; publishing is US $39 plus tax for 90 days of hosting.

records.name: SmartAlgoTrade
records.tagline: Free 1-year license for the Double FX Robot EA
records.description: Download our Free FX Robot to start automating your trades today. Enhance your Forex strategy with reliable, tested, and professional tools.

records.name: Ourly Beta
records.tagline: One shared space for couples to manage life together
records.description: Ourly is a shared space for couples to manage everyday life together. Track personal and shared finances, budgets and savings goals, plan dates, save memories and organize life together — all in one place. Personal information can stay private, while shared moments stay connected with your partner. Ourly is currently in beta, and I'm looking for couples around the world to try it and share honest feedback. ❤️

records.name: SaaS Rank
records.tagline: SaaS leaderboard where founders compete for #1
records.description: SaaS Rank is a paid product leaderboard built around visibility and competition for top positions. Launch Arena is a free feedback space where builders can ask one specific question about their product and get focused input from the community.

records.name: Topkit
records.tagline: Copy, paste, annotate, record screenshots and videos.
records.description: Clipboard history for text and images: search, pin, preview, auto-paste, export. Draw on any app: shapes, freehand, text, stickers, redaction, badges, guides, grids, measurements, across monitors and Spaces. Present with magnifier and halo. Eyedrop colours to clipboard. Screenshot or record windows/regions, annotate, copy or save. Video with optional live subtitles and mic. You can clip videos too. Everything has a global shortcut.

records.name: DWS332 Zigbee Door Sensor
records.tagline: A Zigbee 3.0 door sensor for smarter local automation
records.description: A Zigbee 3.0 door/window sensor for security and smart automation, with tamper detection, long battery life, Zigbee2MQTT and Home Assistant support.

records.name: Talzeno
records.tagline: A smarter workspace for your entire job search.
records.description: Build stronger resumes, prepare for interviews, and manage your job search with Talzeno.

records.name: 20K9
records.tagline: Melee-inspired platform fighter you play in your browser
records.description: The year is 20K9... the only character is "dog"... only stage is "final bark"... no items... A Melee-inspired platform fighter with ranked matchmaking (rollback netcode), Elo ratings, practice mode, and a leaderboard.

records.name: Business Awards India
records.tagline: Celebrating Excellence. Inspiring Success.
records.description: **Business Awards India by Asia Today Media** is a prestigious platform celebrating outstanding businesses, entrepreneurs, leaders, and organizations across India. The awards recognize excellence in **leadership, innovation, entrepreneurship, performance, and contribution** across diverse industries. It provides deserving achievers with a distinguished opportunity to showcase their success, strengthen credibility, enhance visibility, and inspire others.

records.name: ObjectStack AI
records.tagline: Build enterprise apps in one AI context window.
records.description: ObjectStack turns the whole app — data model, UI, workflows, permissions — into typed metadata: a complete CRM in under 150k tokens, one context window.

records.name: PoseDisplay Vault
records.tagline: Photograph any collectible and know what it is worth
records.description: Point your camera at a collectible. PoseDisplay Vault identifies it, reads the condition, and pulls live comps from eBay sold listings, retail and specialist guides to return a value range with a confidence score. 52 categories, one portfolio.

records.name: MGD Payroll
records.tagline: Payroll Management Simplified
records.description: Automated payroll for hourly and commission-based staff. Salary calculation, attendance tracking, commission management, and compliance. Built for Indian businesses.

records.name: BRADIOS
records.tagline: Radio from the Baltics
records.description: Listen to live radio from Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia. Discover Baltic radio stations by country, city, genre and language.
